hidden_space_variance.definition: weighted between-trajectory sum of squares / total sum of squares

interpretation_guardrail: A high seed/format association or collapse after trajectory centering supports a trajectory-level offset explanation.  It does not by itself identify a mechanistic cause, and PCA3 separation is not evidence of a cleaner ordinal representation.

ordinal_decodability.centering_caveat: Per-trajectory centering uses all observed states in each trajectory; it is a diagnostic nuisance removal, not a deployable causal estimator.
